source.citation: 'Widow Must Trim the Trees. Will of the Late John B. Sherman Contains No Provision for Keeping Up His Three Homes.' Chicago Sunday Tribune, 9 August 1903 (vol. LXII, no. 32), p. 1.
what_it_does_not_supply: which of the three homes (Mount Clemens, Newport or Chicago) the trees and lawn belong to: the item does not say
front or rear: 'dooryard' does not place the trees on the lot
the number or kind of trees
what_it_supplies: that the Sherman homes in 1903, the Chicago one among them, had trees and a lawn in the widow's keeping, in the general terms of a court ruling
that the estate would not pay for their upkeep after August 1903
